lead: "3 selected" with the actions on those rows and a button to clear the selection, shown while rows of a table are ticked. `count` is how many are selected (0 hides the bar), the children are the actions, `onClear` clears. It goes with the `selected` of a [DataTable](/data-table); for the tools of the table itself see [TableTools](/table-tools).

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Tick rows: the bar is above the table, in the flow. Clear the selection and it goes.

placement.title: Top or bottom
placement.description: `placement="top"` (the default) is a bar where you put it, above the table. `"bottom"` floats at the bottom edge of the scrolling area while you go through the rows: put it after the table.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: The bar is the `bulk-action-bar` slot (`bulk-action-bar.css`), with `data-placement`; the texts and buttons are Text, Flex and Button.
